public_feedback_schedule: Pre-shared frozen decision tree keyed by average SNR, method and feedback cost; current feedback window is determined solely by the common reliable ACK/NACK history.
schedule_contains: Forward slot/round number, whether a feedback window exists, and stopping rule; already frozen public policy, not transmitter private node objects.
paid_header: Every forward slot still carries its actual 12-bit profile/node ID in 68 symbols. Receiver must parse that ID to select the body decoder. Knowing the public schedule does not bypass or repair a failed/wrong header.
header_failed: Use the previous accepted prefix. Send NACK only when the public tree schedules feedback; no unscheduled ACK/NACK transmission.
decoded_wrong_header: Decode/parse using the actually accepted ID where possible; preserve unknown/mismatched events. The decoded ID/request flag cannot create or cancel the pre-registered public feedback window.
budget_charge: Charge one feedback cost for every scheduled feedback window, including a branch that then stops. Charge zero for unscheduled/final ACKs because those messages are not sent.
QCSI: One paid reliable CSI feedback before its only forward slot; no post-forward ACK.
FIXED_and_C: One forward slot, no multi-round feedback.
codebook_identity: groups + forward_round_index + request_feedback; unique IDs remain within 12 bits.
protocol_authority: Execution-interface clarification bound before physical execution; does not change the frozen base resource or scientific protocol.
